race.comment: ARAPAWA (10) progressive gelding with the three wins from his last four outings. Sat on the slow tempo when he ploughed through the heavy (9) going to score a comfortable win over 1500m here in weaker company. Gets a similar run today with the claim and has solid each way prospects. TARZING (8) lightly raced gelding starting to put it all together. Bounced off his eye-catching first-up third, with a gritty win over this course and distance when defeating Big Papa. Kept up to the mark with a 1030m trial and J Mac hops aboard. Will be strong late. STEEL STRIKE (11) returned from a lengthy break with a tenacious third over 1250m at Canterbury on the heavy track. Ready for this trip now and proven second-up. This race sets up well for him. SILVANITO (7) raced much closer third-up from the good gate when a fighting neck winner over this track and trip. Can handle the weight increase and figure prominently. SUPERNIMA (3) comes up from Victoria fifth-up in search of a firmer surface.
